newsitem.title: USA: US stock fund flow drop in 3-day period - survey.
newsitem.headline: US stock fund flow drop in 3-day period - survey.

text.p: U.S. equity funds posted a drop in cash inflows to $149 million for the three-day period, ended January 9, versus $645 million for the two-day period, ended January 6, according to Mutual Fund Trim Tabs.
International funds experienced an outflow of $35 million compared to an inflow of $474 million, the fund tracking firm said.
Growth funds saw a negative reversal to outflows of $77 million from inflows of $215 million. Aggressive growth funds also saw outflows of $69 million from inflows of $202 million.

Bond funds posted inflows of $73 million versus outflows of flows of $390 million. Muni funds had inflows of $7 million versus outflows $356 million. Government/GNMA had inflows of $1 million versus outflows of $82 million.
